records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating revenues increased 14.2% for the three months ended June 30, 2021, compared to the same period of the prior year.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In our Dedicated fleet, freight demand remained strong in second quarter 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The gross margin percentage can be impacted by the rates charged to customers and the costs of securing third-party capacity.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in average revenues per tractor was due primarily to improved pricing in both Dedicated and One-Way Truckload, offset by a decline in miles per truck from an increased mix of Dedicated trucks to total trucks and fewer team drivers.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Werner Logistics operating margin percentage of 2.8% in second quarter 2021 remained flat, while operating income increased 25% to $3.9 million as other operating expenses declined 6% due to improved automation and efficiency.
